title: Explicit Leakage Bound for Ajtai et al.'s Expander Constructions
summary: The expander-graph constructions tolerate constant leakage, but the corresponding explicit probability value or bound remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine an explicit value or bound for the constant random-probing leakage probability tolerated by the expander-graph construction of Ajtai et al. and its extension. These constructions tolerate a constant leakage probability, but the tolerated probability has not been made explicit.

scope.domain: Random-probing security and leakage tolerance in expander-graph cryptographic constructions.
parameters: constant random-probing leakage probability: tolerated leakage rate
scope.unresolved_remainder: An explicit value or bound for the tolerated constant random-probing leakage probability in these constructions.

citations.label: Random Probing Security: Verification, Composition, Expansion and New Constructions

progress.summary: The source presents the Ajtai et al. construction and its extension as expander-graph approaches that tolerate a constant leakage probability. It identifies the missing explicit tolerated probability as the unresolved issue.
citation_labels: Sonia Belaïd et al., Random Probing Security: Verification, Composition, Expansion and New Constructions
